title: Jeremiyah Love posts second-fastest 40 time among fastest RB group in Combine history

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jeremiyah Love posts second-fastest 40 time among fastest RB group in Combine history
sources.description: Jeremiyah Love came into the Scouting Combine as the top running back on most lists of prospects and his 40-yard dash did not do anything to hurt that standing.
